::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: A public web page for each dataset, made from the metadata submitted with it. It describes the dataset, shows its accession ID and DOI where there is one, and links to [REMS](rems.qmd) to apply for access. No login is needed. Today mostly clinical datasets have one.

Who it's for
: Anyone who wants to know what a dataset contains.

Provided by
: NBIS

Before you start
: [Nothing needed]{.proto-none}

How to get access
: [Browse the dataset landing pages](https://datasets.bigpicture.eu)
